scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @jobnester/web" "npm run dev -w @jobnester/api" "npm run dev -w @jobnester/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jobnester/web && npm run build -w @jobnester/api && npm run build -w @jobnester/worker && node scripts/prepare-site.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests docs scripts *.json *.md *.yaml .github/workflows/*.yml
